headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs fell short in Pittsburgh, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Pirates. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6.0 strong innings. The Minnesota Twins also fell short in Chicago, losing 1-3 to the White Sox. Drew Romo led the Twins' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams. The New York Mets placed center fielder Tyrone Taylor on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip flexor strain. The Colorado Rockies also placed left-hander Jose Quintana on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow sprain. Other teams have made similar moves, including the Washington Nationals, Toronto Blue Jays, Cleveland Guardians, Texas Rangers, and Chicago Cubs.

Several teams have made roster moves in recent days. The Colorado Rockies traded left-hander Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Rockies also acquired right-hander Andrew Baker from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-hander Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for outfielder Rece Hinds. The Chicago White Sox acquired left-hander Joe Rock from the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for third baseman Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 1-2 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, failing to secure a win. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6.0 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, as Drew Romo led the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Anthony Kay earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 5 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Place CF Tyrone Taylor on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Tyrone Taylor, the center fielder for the New York Mets, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hip flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
